name: TAAL Enterprise
verdict_headline: Light entry pending full deep-dive research

four_box.note: Screener.in (as TAAL Tech Ltd, renamed Nov-2025): global ER&D/engineering-services offshoring to India is a genuine structural theme, evidenced by PAT growing Rs37cr->49cr->57cr FY24-26 = tailwind yes; tiny Rs216cr TTM revenue base vs multi-billion-dollar global ER&D TAM = tam yes; people-services business (plant engineering/architecture/aerospace) with limited IP/switching-cost moat beyond OEM approvals = moat weak; P/E 27-31x, P/B ~7x, working-capital days worsening 77->120 = valuation no, already pricing the growth in.
